# steering

> Rulings for coding agents, each with the check that enforces it. Every piece below is fetchable on its own by raw URL. Machine-readable list: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/catalog.json

## Rulings (plain markdown, paste into AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, a steering file or a system prompt)

- [human-attention/ruling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/human-attention/hooks/ruling.md): Few words on screen: the design carries the meaning. Plain markdown to paste into AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, a Kiro steering file or a system prompt.
- [evidence-before-done/ruling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/rulings/evidence-before-done.md): A claim of done carries what was observed. Plain markdown to paste into AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, a Kiro steering file or a system prompt.
- [keep-moving/ruling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/rulings/keep-moving.md): No stalling on a wait, no rerunning what cannot change. Plain markdown to paste into AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, a Kiro steering file or a system prompt.
- [model-tiering/ruling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/rulings/model-tiering.md): Every dispatch names its model, chosen by what would catch a wrong answer. Plain markdown to paste into AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, a Kiro steering file or a system prompt.
- [isolated-dispatch/ruling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/rulings/isolated-dispatch.md): Editing agents get their own worktree; nobody's uncommitted work is hidden. Plain markdown to paste into AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, a Kiro steering file or a system prompt.
- [remediation-ladder/ruling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/rulings/remediation-ladder.md): Fix the cause at the highest rung: eliminate, automate, then inform. Plain markdown to paste into AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, a Kiro steering file or a system prompt.
- [falsify-your-gate/ruling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/rulings/falsify-your-gate.md): A check counts only after you have seen it fail. Plain markdown to paste into AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, a Kiro steering file or a system prompt.
- [plain-prose/ruling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/plain-prose/hooks/ruling.md): Prose a person reads once: one idea per sentence, plain words, no AI tells. Plain markdown to paste into AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, a Kiro steering file or a system prompt.
- [ub-mode/ruling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/rulings/ub-mode.md): Make it work, then make it right, measured. Plain markdown to paste into AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, a Kiro steering file or a system prompt.

## Skills (Agent Skills folders; fetch SKILL.md, then the other files listed)

## Checks (Python 3 scripts; JSON on stdin, exit 2 blocks or reports)

- [human-attention/check/copy-audit-hook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/human-attention/skills/human-attention/scripts/copy-audit-hook): Report the copy an edit adds to a UI file. Needs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/human-attention/skills/human-attention/scripts/copy-audit, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/human-attention/skills/human-attention/scripts/steering_hits.py.
- [human-attention/check/copy-audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/human-attention/skills/human-attention/scripts/copy-audit): List the text a person will see in UI source and count the usual excess.
- [evidence-before-done/check/unfinished-guard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/evidence-before-done/hooks/unfinished-guard): Report stubs and suppressions an edit adds.
- [evidence-before-done/check/visual-proof-guard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/evidence-before-done/hooks/visual-proof-guard): Send the agent back once when it edited a UI file and never looked at a rendered result.
- [evidence-before-done/check/cue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/evidence-before-done/hooks/cue): Say the rule when the prompt calls for it. Needs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/evidence-before-done/hooks/cues.json.
- [keep-moving/check/rerun-guard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/keep-moving/hooks/rerun-guard): Block the third identical build or test run when no file changed.
- [keep-moving/check/cue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/keep-moving/hooks/cue): Say the rule when the prompt calls for it. Needs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/keep-moving/hooks/cues.json.
- [model-tiering/check/dispatch-model-guard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/model-tiering/hooks/dispatch-model-guard): Block a subagent dispatch that names no model.
- [model-tiering/check/cue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/model-tiering/hooks/cue): Say the rule when the prompt calls for it. Needs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/model-tiering/hooks/cues.json.
- [isolated-dispatch/check/dispatch-isolation-guard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/isolated-dispatch/hooks/dispatch-isolation-guard): Block a dispatch that asks for edits and sets no isolation.
- [isolated-dispatch/check/stash-guard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/isolated-dispatch/hooks/stash-guard): Block an anonymous `git stash` and a `pop` or `drop` that names no entry.
- [isolated-dispatch/check/cue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/isolated-dispatch/hooks/cue): Say the rule when the prompt calls for it. Needs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/isolated-dispatch/hooks/cues.json.
- [remediation-ladder/check/bypass-guard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/remediation-ladder/hooks/bypass-guard): Block a command that skips a check instead of passing it.
- [remediation-ladder/check/cue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/remediation-ladder/hooks/cue): Say the rule when the prompt calls for it. Needs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/remediation-ladder/hooks/cues.json.
- [falsify-your-gate/check/vacuous-test-guard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/falsify-your-gate/hooks/vacuous-test-guard): Report a test an edit adds that cannot fail.
- [falsify-your-gate/check/cue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/falsify-your-gate/hooks/cue): Say the rule when the prompt calls for it. Needs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/falsify-your-gate/hooks/cues.json.
- [plain-prose/check/prose-guard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/plain-prose/hooks/prose-guard): Report heavy prose in an edited document, and block a heavy commit message or PR body once. Needs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/plain-prose/skills/ste80-humanizer/scripts/ste_check.py, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/plain-prose/hooks/steering_hits.py, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/plain-prose/hooks/prose_score.py.
- [plain-prose/check/ste_check.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/plain-prose/skills/ste80-humanizer/scripts/ste_check.py): Upstream linter for AI tells and STE-style English.
- [plain-prose/check/cue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/plain-prose/hooks/cue): Say the rule when the prompt calls for it. Needs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/plain-prose/hooks/cues.json.
- [ub-mode/check/ub-gate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/ub-mode/bin/ub-gate): Run unclebob's crapper, dryer and mutator at pinned versions with no network. Needs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/ub-mode/bin/ub_gate_dry.py, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/ub-mode/bin/simjoin.py, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/ub-mode/lock/pins.json, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/ub-mode/lock/requirements.lock.
- [ub-mode/check/cue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/ub-mode/hooks/cue): Say the rule when the prompt calls for it. Needs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/ub-mode/hooks/cues.json.

## Adapters (per-harness wiring)

- [adapter/shim](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/adapters/shim): Translate a Codex, Gemini CLI, Kiro CLI or oh-my-pi hook event to the Claude Code event the checks read, and run a check.
- [adapter/claude-code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/adapters/claude-code.md): How to wire the rulings, skills and checks into Claude Code, with the hook events, input shapes and what can block.
- [adapter/codex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/adapters/codex.md): How to wire the rulings, skills and checks into Codex CLI, with the hook events, input shapes and what can block.
- [adapter/gemini](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/adapters/gemini.md): How to wire the rulings, skills and checks into Gemini CLI, with the hook events, input shapes and what can block.
- [adapter/kiro](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/adapters/kiro.md): How to wire the rulings, skills and checks into Kiro CLI, with the hook events, input shapes and what can block.
- [adapter/omp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/adapters/omp.md): How to wire the rulings, skills and checks into oh-my-pi, with the hook events, input shapes and what can block.
- [adapter/claude-code/evidence-before-done](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warxhead1/nervous-bus/main/steering/adapters/claude-code/evidence-before-done.settings.json): Hook config that runs the evidence-before-done checks in Claude Code.
